title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Issues Concerning the Special Campaign to Combat Obscene and Pornographic Websites in Accordance with the Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Notice on the Relevant Work concerning the Special Campaign to Crack Down on Pornographic Websites in accordance with the Law

Gong Tong Zi [2004] No. 53

The Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, and the Public Security Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

At present, pornographic websites are spreading and proliferating, seriously endangering the healthy growth of minors, corrupting social morality, and inducing various criminal activities, drawing strong reactions from all sectors of society and the general public. In order to effectively eliminate pornographic websites, resolutely crack down on online obscene and pornographic activities, create a healthy online environment, and maintain social order and stability, a nationwide special campaign to crack down on pornographic websites will be carried out from mid-July this year until before National Day (October 1). Notice is hereby given on the relevant work concerning this special campaign as follows:

1. Fully understand the significant importance of carrying out the special campaign to crack down on pornographic websites, and effectively enhance political responsibility and a sense of urgency in the work.

The Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China clearly pointed out that "to build a moderately prosperous society in an all-round way, we must vigorously develop socialist culture and build socialist spiritual civilization"; "vigorously develop advanced culture, support healthy and beneficial culture, strive to transform backward culture, and resolutely resist decadent culture." The obscene and pornographic information disseminated by pornographic websites is a prominent manifestation of decadent culture and runs completely counter to strengthening socialist spiritual civilization. Carrying out the special campaign to crack down on pornographic websites is an inevitable requirement for strengthening socialist spiritual civilization construction, an urgent need to protect the physical and mental health of minors, and an important measure to realize and safeguard the fundamental interests of the broad masses. Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels must deeply understand the serious harm of pornographic websites and the importance and urgency of cracking down on pornographic websites and purifying the online environment. From the strategic height of thoroughly implementing the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Party and diligently practicing the important thought of "Three Represents," and maintaining the long-term stability of the country, with an attitude of high responsibility towards the Party and the people, they should give full play to their respective departmental functions, deploy carefully, cooperate closely, resolutely eradicate the ugly social phenomena in the network, effectively deter crime, purify the social environment, and promote the construction of socialist spiritual civilization.

2. Fully utilize legal weapons and highlight the key targets of the crackdown.

Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels must accurately grasp the characteristics of such illegal and criminal activities, give full play to their respective functions, and crack down severely on lawbreakers who use pornographic websites to engage in illegal and criminal activities in accordance with the law. Through this special campaign, they shall solve a number of cases involving the production, sale, and dissemination of obscene materials and organizing prostitution using the Internet as a medium, dismantle a number of criminal gangs, and severely punish a number of criminals and business entities operating pornographic websites or engaging in illegal activities using the Internet.

In the special campaign, they must strictly comply with the provisions of the Criminal Law, the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Maintaining Internet Security, and relevant judicial interpretations, handle cases strictly according to law, correctly grasp the boundary between crime and non-crime, and ensure the quality of case handling. For those engaging in criminal activities using the Internet, depending on their specific acts, they shall be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the law under the crimes of producing, reproducing, publishing, selling, or disseminating obscene materials for profit, the crime of disseminating obscene materials, the crime of organizing the playing of obscene audio-visual products, and other relevant charges stipulated in the Criminal Law. For those who, in violation of state regulations, illegally establish Internet access service business premises or illegally engage in Internet access service business operations, if the circumstances are serious and constitute a crime, they shall be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of illegal business operations. For those who establish pornographic websites or webpages, provide obscene information involving minors, use youth education networks to engage in obscene and pornographic activities, or commit flagrant offenses with serious crimes, they must be resolutely and severely punished according to law, and it is strictly prohibited to substitute fines for criminal penalties. Measures such as confiscating criminal tools, recovering illegal gains, and property penalties such as confiscation of property and fines shall be fully utilized to increase economic sanctions against criminals, resolutely eliminate the survival basis of pornographic websites, and completely deprive criminals of their capital for illegal profits and re-offending.

The criminal policy of combining punishment with leniency shall be adhered to, with differentiation, timely assessment, and a balance of leniency and severity, to maximize the division and disintegration of criminals; those who voluntarily surrender or perform meritorious acts such as reporting or exposing obscene and pornographic illegal activities may be given lenient punishment according to law.

3. Strengthen coordination and cooperation to form a joint force for cracking down.

Currently, illegal and criminal activities involving pornographic websites are not only numerous but also highly technical, widely disseminated, use covert methods of committing crimes, and have strong capabilities to evade crackdowns. Public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels must, in handling cases, adhere to the principle of seeking truth from facts, scientifically and correctly understand the particularity of such criminal activities, follow the principle of "basic facts clear, basic evidence conclusive," avoid entanglement in trivial details, closely cooperate, work together, and crack down severely and swiftly on various criminal activities using pornographic websites according to law. Public security organs should organize specialized forces to conduct thorough investigation work. Upon discovering a pornographic website, the public security organ in the location of the pornographic website and the public security organ in the place of residence of the producer or maintainer of the pornographic website shall immediately initiate a criminal investigation according to law, make every effort to solve cases involving crimes using pornographic websites, and apprehend criminal suspects. They must conscientiously collect, fix, and preserve evidence, and produce electronic data obtained during the investigation into electronic evidence document discs as evidence to be transferred together with other evidence in the case, laying a solid foundation for prosecution and trial. The people's procuratorates shall promptly approve arrests and initiate public prosecutions according to law for criminal suspects for whom the public security organs request approval of arrest or transfer for review and prosecution. The people's courts shall promptly adjudicate cases for which the people's procuratorates initiate public prosecutions according to law. When differences arise among public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts at all levels regarding issues such as case characterization, evidence determination, or case jurisdiction, they shall strengthen communication and coordination, speed up the case progress, improve case handling efficiency, form a joint force for cracking down, and effectively deter crime.

4. Strengthen publicity efforts to promote the in-depth development of the special campaign.

During the special campaign, public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts shall make full use of various news media, publicize relevant laws and policies through typical cases, and demonstrate to the masses the determination and confidence of the Party, the government, and the political and legal organs in cracking down on pornographic websites. They shall select typical cases for public exposure to deter crime, promote the rule of law, educate the masses, and enable netizens, especially minors, to establish a law-abiding awareness and consciously stay away from and resist pornographic websites. They shall mobilize the masses to report and expose crimes by setting up reporting hotlines and reporting websites, forming a social force to crack down on pornographic websites.

Upon receipt of this notice, all localities shall immediately deploy and implement it. Problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security respectively.

July 16, 2004
